entries.headline: USAF transports and surveillance aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance jet airborne over the continental United States, describing activity as slightly elevated based on recent reports.

entries.headline: Rubio accountability demand over explosives shipment relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that Rubio urged Aoun to hold accountable those who ordered, financed and directed a shipment of hundreds of kilograms of explosives. The post did not identify the shipment's stated origin.

entries.headline: Six US military transports and additional aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six military transport aircraft airborne over the United States, along with a Navy surveillance jet, an atmospheric-sampling aircraft and a distress signal from a US Air Force aircraft.

entries.headline: White House decision on Ukraine Starshield service relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an OSINTdefender report that the decision to limit the Starshield satellite service used by Ukraine's military came from inside the White House, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: WC-135R FENIX31 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing WC-135R using callsign FENIX31, hex AE07C6 and registration 64-14831, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Thomas Walker via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Ukrainian drone raid and explosions in Moscow reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an ongoing Ukrainian drone raid targeting Moscow and numerous explosions in the Moscow area, citing reagan0965.

entries.headline: Boeing E-6 Mercury AEBA38 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6 Mercury with hex AEBA38 and no callsign, citing a sighting by reagan0965.

entries.headline: RC-135V Rivet Joint HOOVR92 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing RC-135V Rivet Joint using callsign HOOVR92, hex AE01CA and registration 63-9792, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by EdwinS via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Transport, surveillance and radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported US military transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with 23 coded radio broadcasts heard that day and none during the preceding two hours.

entries.headline: US Army Dash 8 GKA610 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch reported a De Havilland DHC-8-300 Dash 8 associated with the US Army Parachute Team, using callsign GKA610, hex A60BA5 and registration 17-01610, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Steven Ma via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Iranian armored vehicle movement reported near Iraqi border
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Monitor X report of Iranian armored vehicles and tanks moving in southwestern Iran near the Iraqi border.

entries.headline: C-17A 03-3114 spotted from Ramstein
entries.summary: War Watch identified a US Air Force Boeing C-17A Globemaster III with registration 03-3114, hex AE1197 and callsign X, reported from Ramstein, Germany, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767 and a photo by Sybille Petersen via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: MQ-72C cargo-drone demonstration highlighted
